 Sara Ali Khan was seen in tears while offering prayers at the Golden Temple in Amritsar, with a video of her visit gaining attention on social media. The actress appeared deeply moved during the visit. Sara is currently promoting her upcoming film 'Udta Teer', which stars Ayushmann Khurrana alongside her. The actors have been travelling across Punjab as part of the promotional campaign. On Tuesday, Sara also shared a photograph with Ayushmann from the Golden Temple, accompanied by a festive message for Dussehra. Their visit comes just days before the film's scheduled theatrical release on October 23, 2026. Sara Ali Khan breaks down while offering prayers
 A video from Sara Ali Khan's visit to the Golden Temple shows the actress becoming emotional as she stands in prayer at the Sikh shrine. Dressed in traditional attire, Sara appeared visibly moved during the visit. Watch ‘Hello Yellow!’: Sara Ali Khan radiates elegance in comfy clothes at airport Sara Ali Khan shares Dussehra wishes with Ayushmann Khurrana
 Sara Ali Khan took to Instagram on Tuesday to share a photograph featuring herself and Ayushmann Khurrana in front of the Golden Temple. Both actors wore white ethnic outfits and posed with their hands folded. Alongside the picture, Sara extended her wishes to her followers for the festive occasion. She wrote, "Happy Dussehra (folded hands and two heart emojis) Wishing everyone love, luck and laughter (hug emoticon) (sic)." 'Udta Teer' promotions take the actors across Punjab
 Sara Ali Khan and Ayushmann Khurrana have been visiting locations across Punjab to promote their upcoming film. Their promotional appearances have included experiences connected to the region's food and cultural traditions. Ayushmann Khurrana, who hails from Chandigarh, was recently seen enjoying a large glass of traditional Punjabi lassi.
